tools.name: create_clips
tools.description: Start a job that cuts a video link (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Vimeo, Twitch, or a direct file URL) into vertical 9:16 short clips with burned-in subtitles. Returns a job_id immediately; the job runs for a few minutes — poll get_job until status is "completed" or "partial". num_clips is a maximum,

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Status of a job created with create_clips: status (pending, processing, completed, partial, failed), progress counters, source info and the list of finished clips with download_url. Poll every 10–15 seconds. "partial" means some clips are usable.

tools.name: list_clips
tools.description: Only the finished clips of a job (id, title, duration, download_url). Each download_url requires the same Bearer key; public_url opens without the key for about 6 hours.

tools.name: get_options
tools.description: All accepted values for layout, subtitle_style, title_style, font, subtitle_position with "when to choose" hints and recommendations by content type (podcast, gaming, humor…). Call once before create_clips to pick styling.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "list_clips" references sensitive artifacts (bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_clips" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Only the finished clips of a job (id, title, duration, download_url). Each download_url requires the same Bearer key." → after: "Only the finished clips of a job (id, title, duration, download_url). Each download_url requires the same Bearer key; public_url opens without the key for about 6 hours."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
